title: Scene-thumbnail asset map fragment
description:
Layered overlay enforcing the patternProperties wrapper, ULID key format, and per-entry value shape for per-Scene thumbnail asset entries inside a STAC Item's `assets` map. The value shape is sourced via $ref from the LinkML-generated SceneThumbnailAssetEntry — single source of truth via Constitution Article II.

This overlay covers schema rule scene-thumbnail-key-format-rule-001 (key format). Pair invariant (scene-thumbnail-pair-rule-001) and orphan rule (scene-thumbnail-orphan-rule-001) are enforced by services/stac/src/debrief_stac/scene_thumbnail_audit.py — not by this schema.

See specs/243-scene-asset-contract/ for migration history.

propertyNames.$comment: scene-thumbnail-key-format-rule-001 — any key beginning with the literal `scene-thumbnail-` MUST match the full ULID-suffixed pattern. Non-matching keys (e.g. `thumbnail`, `overview`, `features`, `source-*`) are unaffected by this overlay.

^scene-thumbnail-[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}(.$comment: Value shape sourced from the LinkML-generated SceneThumbnailAssetEntry. The `roles` constraint is tightened to exactly ['thumbnail'] (LinkML emits a generic array; the overlay layers the const).
